recognize_zh: 淋巴結被瀰漫性、中型至略大的淋巴細胞取代，其間散在許多淡染、含吞噬碎屑的易染體巨噬細胞（tingible-body macrophages，箭頭）形成星空樣（starry sky）外觀，並有凋亡小體；形態像 Burkitt 淋巴瘤，但無 MYC 重組而有 11q 異常，診斷為具 11q 異常的 Burkitt 樣淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Round to irregular, somewhat squared-off nuclei with fine to dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Numerous tingible-body macrophages with pale cytoplasm containing apoptotic debris (arrowhead), producing a starry-sky pattern
Frequent apoptotic bodies; slightly more nuclear pleomorphism than classic Burkitt lymphoma
Small scattered vessels within the diffuse infiltrate
describe_en: Sections of lymph node show diffuse effacement of the architecture by sheets of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Numerous tingible-body macrophages containing apoptotic debris (arrowhead) impart a starry-sky appearance, and apoptotic bodies are frequent. Cytologically, the cells show slightly more pleomorphism than typical Burkitt lymphoma. In conjunction with a CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2- germinal center phenotype, absence of MYC rearrangement, and 11q gain/loss pattern on FISH, findings are consistent with Burkitt-like lymphoma with 11q aberration (high-grade B-cell lymphoma with 11q aberration).

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma is morphologically similar but more monotonous and carries an IG::MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%, whereas 11q aberration lacks MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma shows MYC plus BCL2 rearrangements on FISH and is usually BCL2 positive, unlike this BCL2-negative case without rearrangements.
DLBCL cells are generally larger with vesicular chromatin and more cytoplasm, a less prominent starry-sky pattern, and a lower proliferation index.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finely stippled blastic chromatin and is TdT/CD34 positive, with a less conspicuous starry-sky pattern.
